title: Weak Averaging Principle and Weak Pullback Attractors for Mckean--Vlasov Stochastic Navier--Stokes Equations
summary: We establish three weak averaging principles for distribution-dependent stochastic Navier--Stokes equations with rapidly oscillating coefficients on the torus $\T^2$. First, solution laws are relatively compact on finite time intervals, and every limit point as $\var\to0$ is the path law of a variational martingale solution of the averaged equation. Under a dissipative condition, we can choose bounded complete variational solution laws of the original and averaged equations so that every sequence with $\var\to0$ has a subsequence converging weakly to a bounded complete variational solution…
